name: token-meter
description: Logs token counts per model request and agent to a JSONL file; /tokens prints a zero-token summary.

logDir.title: Log directory
logDir.description: Absolute directory for the per-session JSONL files. Empty: the plugin data directory.

partKb.title: Part size (KB)
partKb.description: A session's log rolls over to a new part file before this size (1 to 3584; file reads stop at 4 MiB).
